name: Jordan's Refined Ore Shipment
summary: Jordan's Refined Ore Shipment reaches Ironforge for a paladin's sacred trials. The high-grade metal is prepared for blacksmith Jordan Stilwell to forge a holy weapon of virtue.

sections.title: A Smith's Materials
sections.body: Jordan Stilwell needs rare, exacting materials to forge a weapon worthy of a dedicated paladin. The set includes a Purified Kor Gem, sturdy Whitestone Oak lumber, his lost smithing hammer, and a shipment of refined ore. This consignment supplies the metal for the sacred labor, brought to Ironforge for the Test of Righteousness.

faq.q: What is Jordan's Refined Ore Shipment used for?
aliases: what does jordan do with ore
faq.answer: The refined ore goes to Jordan Stilwell outside Ironforge as one of four key components for forging a masterwork weapon for paladins undertaking the Test of Righteousness.
Bailor arranges the shipment and oversees the refining and dispatch of the specialist metal Jordan Stilwell needs.

faq.q: Why does Jordan need this specific shipment?
aliases: why cant jordan use regular iron
faq.answer: Jordan Stilwell plans to craft a symbol of paladinhood and the Light, so he needs superior materials beyond ordinary forge scraps. The specially processed metal gives the blade or hammer head the balance and purity worthy of a holy knight.

angles.text: As a paladin, procuring this refined shipment tests your patience and dedication. It is one of the physical trials required to craft your symbolic weapon of the Light.
As a blacksmith, you know masterwork forging calls for flawless, carefully prepared ingots instead of raw field ore.
